_comment: SCRABLE gRPC server for the backend (CustomerAssistant.DraftReply). Stage-4 photo model (outputs/stage4_photo/adapter, from scrable-stage4-photo-adapter.zip) and its prompt; for the older stage-2 model use outputs/stage2/adapter with prompts/stage1_best_prompt.txt; store documents from data/store_docs/<store_id>. store_aliases maps a backend store_id to a documents folder, e.g. {"1": "bunsik-01"}.
